record.question: Which of the following does not take part in the elections of the President of India?
options: Elected members of the Lok Sabha
Elected members of the Rajya Sabha
record.explanation: Answer C: Members of the Legislative Council. Members of Legislative Councils do not vote in the presidential electoral college. Article 54 includes elected members of both Houses of Parliament and elected members of state Legislative Assemblies; it does not include Legislative Council members. Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
